Paragraph: "Perplexity be warded off... all of you discarded that great fear from Vali or his cruelty... there is no scare from Vali here on this best mountain, for it is Mt. Malaya..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Addressing irrational fear based on place and context misjudgment.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuma reminds the group of the sanctuary rules of Mt. Malaya/Rishyamuka where Vali cannot step.
Outcome/Resolution: He establishes environmental safety to de-escalate panic.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Abhaya-Dana (Granting assurance of safety based on spiritual truth and sanctuary)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Reminds the soul that in the sacred sanctuary (Mt. Rishyamuka), evil forces cannot violate divine protection.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Reality testing: grounding a panicking individual by highlighting objective, structural safety factors.
